text:
You need a WordPress developer who has real Salient / WpBakery experience and can customize the theme reliably for a long-term role.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and improving web experiences with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I want to be upfront: my strongest recent work has been in modern frontend and full-stack development rather than WordPress theme work, so I would not want to misrepresent Salient-specific experience I don’t have.

One project I can share is the Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS that the marketing team could edit themselves. That work improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months. It’s the kind of project where careful implementation, performance tuning, and clean handoff mattered a lot.

If your priority is Salient customization specifically, I may not be the right fit unless you’re also open to someone who can work on the broader frontend experience, performance, and integrations around the WordPress setup. I do work comfortably across full-stack projects, and I’m used to collaborating closely, maintaining code quality, and shipping changes in a way that’s easy for a team to continue using.

I’m also comfortable working in a schedule that overlaps with EST, including a 3–4 pm EST window for ongoing communication if needed.

If you’re still considering candidates beyond direct Salient specialists, I’d be happy to discuss the exact theme changes you need, the level of customization involved, and whether the work is mostly visual adjustments, template edits, or deeper functionality changes. What parts of the Salient theme do you need customized most urgently?
